source.description: Prepared editorial revision. UNC DocSouth transcription of the Murrey Atkins Library, UNC Charlotte copy, Boston 1845. No running heads or indentation were encoded by this witness. source.description: New transcription of the complete dialogue from the 1817 scan, printed pp. 240–242 (PDF pages 246–248). Internet Archive, columbianorator00inbing; Lincoln Financial Foundation Collection. Source hash identifies the full downloaded PDF. Speaker labels and emphasis retained; prose reflowed, line-end hyphenation joined, typesetting spaces normalized. No scan images included.

Complete chapter text, headings and argument from UNC DocSouth’s 1999 electronic edition of the 1881 Park Publishing book, compared throughout with Princeton University Library’s 1881 print scan, N-002898. Six witnessed transcription repairs; printed apostrophes represented by U+2019. Prose reflowed, line-end hyphenation joined and typesetting spaces normalized. The interleaved home illustration is described in the source note, not reproduced. Source hash identifies the complete downloaded UNC XML.

New transcription from official GovInfo STATUTE-1-Pg302.pdf, four-page scan of 1 Stat. 302–305. Complete statutory Sections 3 and 4; later case annotations and their call marker, marginal summaries, running heads and other statutory sections excluded. Original wording, spelling, punctuation and italic enacting clauses retained; prose line wraps and unambiguous divided-word hyphens joined. Printed north-west hyphen retained. No scan images included.
